checks: New runs start with all nine ruins, no working facilities, and HQ as the only repair
HQ validates proximity, life, site and full cost; pays once; unlocks Level 1 without moving the player or layout
Broken workshop, warehouse, water, fire and bunker cannot be used; logs alone restore workshop and craft the first pickaxe
All repairs persist, re-enable their facilities, and permit Camp Level 2 and furnace progression
Repair progress survives interior travel, saving below ground and returning to camp
Existing saves and sandbox keep their facilities; malformed repair saves are rejected
All ruin sprites preload and render to exact authored bounds, including rotated/flipped placements; editor layout stays untouched
